early_close_condition: This market will close and expire after the record is broken.
rules_primary: If Myles Garrett Breaks the Pro Football Regular Season Sack Record (ties do not count) in the 2025-26 season, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: The current Pro Football Regular Season Sack Record is 22.5 sacks. Myles Garrett must finish the regular season with more than 22.5 sacks to be considered as breaking the record.
title: Will Myles Garrett break the pro football regular season sack record in 2025-26 season?
